title: Weakly etale base change for the coefficient-facing site functors
statement: For schemes Uprime, U, Zprime, Z, arrows gprime:Uprime→U, jprime:Uprime→Zprime, j:U→Z and g:Zprime→Z forming a cartesian square, with j and jprime weakly etale, the coefficient-facing pro-etale sheaf functors have an invertible base-change transformation j^* g_* → gprime_* jprime^*. It is the mate of the squareLowerStarIso built from the specified composition and congruence isomorphisms. The sheaf coefficient category A is abelian and Grothendieck abelian in the project universe convention. This is the existing source-library weakly-etale base-change theorem, transported to the coefficient-facing functor imports.

proof.text: Apply the existing theorem AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isIso_baseChangeMap_of_isPullback in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.BaseChange.WeaklyEtale. The current legacy imports re-export the canonical coefficient implementation, so this theorem applies directly to the coefficient-facing functors; no transport or copied proof is needed.

The explicit site comparison has mate squareLowerStarIso, as follows objectwise from the unit/counit and pullback composition formulas. Transport localization restriction to upperStar using adjoint uniqueness; mate invariance identifies the transported comparison with the displayed base-change map. Its components are therefore invertible.
